customer_persona: Rajesh Kulkarni bought a defective tablet and is shocked when told refunds are wallet-only and address was revealed unverified.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, thank you for dialing ShopEase. My name is Priya Sen. This call is being recorded for quality monitoring purposes. How may I assist you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Priya, my name is Rajesh Kulkarni. I purchased an Android tablet that arrived yesterday and the touchscreen is continuously flickering.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello Mr. Kulkarni, I see your order for the tablet was delivered to flat 402, Palm Heights in Pune yesterday. What seems to be the trouble?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is my flat. When I turn on the display, random green lines flicker across the screen, so I want to send it back and receive my money back.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see. Let me look into our return guidelines for this tablet model.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, please tell me how quickly you can collect it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: For portable electronics and tablets, our return window is strictly limited to 3 days from delivery date, so after today you would not have been eligible.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Well, good thing I called right away then. The courier can pick it up tomorrow, right?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I can arrange a return pickup within 48 hours. The courier will inspect the unit and collect the box.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. I paid Rs 14,999 on my Visa credit card, so please credit it back to that card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Since you purchased this during the weekend clearance sale, refunds cannot be returned to your Visa card; the amount of Rs 14,999 will only be credited as ShopEase wallet credits for future purchases.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: What? Why would I want wallet credits? I paid with real money from my card and the device is defective!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Clearance items are strictly non-refundable to card accounts under our system policies; only store credits can be offered.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is very disappointing. Let me speak to someone who can process a proper bank refund.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our payment backend restricts promotional orders to wallet refunds only, so another representative would tell you the exact same thing.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I will take this up separately then. Good day.

policy_violations.said: Hello Mr. Kulkarni, I see your order for the tablet was delivered to flat 402, Palm Heights in Pune yesterday. What seems to be the trouble?
policy_violations.correct_fact: Customer identity must be verified using Order ID and last 4 mobile digits before disclosing delivery address or order particulars.

policy_violations.said: For portable electronics and tablets, our return window is strictly limited to 3 days from delivery date, so after today you would not have been eligible.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Electronic items carry a return window of 7 calendar days from delivery, not 3 days.

policy_violations.said: Since you purchased this during the weekend clearance sale, refunds cannot be returned to your Visa card; the amount of Rs 14,999 will only be credited as ShopEase wallet credits for future purchases.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Refunds must always be credited back to the original payment source used during purchase.
